notes.title: DLC & Gratitude
notes.content:
[h1]THANK YOU FOR PLAYING[/h1]
Throughout the past six months, we've seen a steady growth of interest for our goofy ah game, and we cannot thank each and everyone one of you enough. So instead we wanted to take this opportunity to let you homies know what we got goin on at Trepang Studios, what's next, and what to expect.

---

What we've been working on
[list]
[*] Build-a-Merc
[*] GOG Update
[*] Horde Mode Music Randomizer
[*] Merch
[*] Story & Sword DLC
[/list]
[h2]Build-a-Merc[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906859/6f1e6ca1b4f03d03cb702756076a1bdb43fab9b7.png[/img]
Okay, hear us out. How cool would it be to create your own NPCs to fight along side you, or to blast into clown dust? From the beginning of development, we've been wanting to add the option for the player to create their own NPCs. Changing things like their camo, hats, glasses, etc, and overall just fun goofy stuff. We hope to have this ready by the Sword DLC release.

[h2]GOG Update[/h2]
If you bought the game on GOG, [b][u]we hear you[/u].[/b] Due to unforeseen circumstances (lol) our GOG release will be updated in January. There is unfortunately nothing else I can report on that at this current moment, and apologize for the huge delay. We hear you, we agree with you, January.

[h2]Horde Mode Music Randomizer[/h2]
NO LONGER will you hear the same 5 songs on the beginning of your horde runs lmao. Songs are now randomized and will display the song name so you won't have to painstakingly go through the OST to find the jam to lift your weights to.

[h2]Merch[/h2]
[url=https://trepang2-shop.fourthwall.com/collections/all]WE HAVE MERCH[/url]
Including but not limited to:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906859/2d272275766aa34731c3a8cf39ab207eccadcd92.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35906859/f5b1eb65aa5fd8c6df4b760415abd664838da3a6.png[/img]

[h2]Story & Sword DLC[/h2]
To be released in 2024, we have a new DLC approaching. Not much we want say at this moment, other than anticipate slicing and dicing nerds that look at you funny.

---

As we've been hard at work on more DLC for Trepang2, you homies have been hard at work making amazing screenshots and fan art of Trepang2. We want to take this opportunity to thank you all so much, and to show everyone some (and definitely not all) stuff that some people have made for us our [url=https://www.trepang2.com/discord]Discord[/url].

notes.title: September 2023 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]PATCH 1 Out Now[/h2]
Oh jeez oh gosh oh goodness its trepangin' time.
-----------------------------------------
[u][h1]Bug Fixes For Patch 1[/h1][/u]
This patch includes a smorgasbord of fixes, including but not limited to:
[list]

CONTROLLER
[*] Significantly improved controller support, aim assist, melee lockon
[*] New controller settings for deadzone, aim acceleration curve
[*] Analogue controller directional movement (was locked to WASD axis before)
[*] Fixed controller not being able to interact with mission menu after completing campaign

OPTIONS:
[*] Toggle sprint option for keyboard and controller
[*] Fixed UI text being too small on steam deck

COMBAT SIMULATOR: 
[*] Fixed missing music, weapon benches in combat simulator maps
[*] Fixed missing floor collisions in "The Shard" combat simulator map
[*] Fixed wall with missing collisions in Reactor combat simulator map
[*] Fixed soft lock on killing waves with only 1 enemy too quickly

WEAPONS:
[*] Shotgun infinite reload bug squashed and thrown out
[*] Fixed grenade launcher homing projectile particle spam on hitting the floor
[*] Fixed dual wield weapon customizations not appearing after loading a game or returning to safehouse

CAMPAIGN/SIDE MISSIONS:
[*] Fixed crash on spawnkilling enemies with proximity mines or incendiary shotgun (most noticeable in oil rig)
[*] Fixed wall missing collision in Jorvik Castle library
[*] Fixed firebombs not being picked up in Jorvik Castle
[*] Fixed Pandora Institute floating TV screen
[*] Fixed Pandora Institute missing wall collision after entering the tower
[*] Fixed Site32/Unidentified Structure enemies getting stuck in outside of map

TMOD: 
[*] Fixed tmod "FlashlightOn" and "SpawnWithRifleShield" buttons getting stuck
[*] Fixed tmod spawned HVTs counting towards HVT kills
[*] Fixed tmod buddha mode remaining on after tmod disabled

MISC: 
[*] Numerous localization fixes (thank you Lionbridge Games) ♥
[*] Fixed slide being queued if pressed while stamina is empty
[*] Bunch of soft locks are soft locked outta the game shoo
[*] All achievements now trigger properly (Average Weapon Enjoyer, 50 Shades of Burnt, & more)
[*] Various music fixes
[*] "Lowest Difficulty This Level" now being saved correctly, affected by cheats
[*] Fixed UI slider values turning to 0 (this only occurred with European languages)
[*] Fixed Hazardous camo's misaligned textures
[*] Fixed supply box not being affected by "Music" volume setting
[*] Safehouse Infiltrator HVT now has a small chance of spawning even after he's been killed once
[*] Tons of little bugs are now fumigated and sent off to Pandora Institute.

These were mostly reported by players, thanks so much for finding these and letting us know!
[/list]
-----------------------------------------

We also worked on some weapon skins, that we'd love for you to try for yourself! These will be included in Patch 1. They can be accessed at weapon benches (where you customize your weapons). Each skin requires completing a map, you'll have to work to earn them all.

notes.title: Trepang2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Homies, it’s time! Trepang2 is now available on Steam! [/h3]

We can’t believe we’re finally typing out these words. What a rollercoaster of a journey for the devs here at Trepang Studios. Thank you for the endless support and determination to help us see Trepang2 through to release, we thoroughly appreciate every single one of you. 

Please don’t hesitate to share your feedback with us, we’re so excited to see what you think of your voyage of destruction with the relentless Subject 106. Enjoy the carnage. Enjoy reprimanding those that have the gumption to contend with your abilities; your unwavering, unadulterated focus to getting the job done. 

Retribution awaits… Conspiracies are there to be unravelled... Unimaginable horrors will greet you...

[h3]BREAK. THE. CYCLE.[/h3]

[i]Acquaint yourselves with carnage and horror in our launch trailer[/i]
[previewyoutube=pIhx-Lgqi_E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Trepang2 Key Features [/h3]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Over-the-top action:[/b] Dive into a bullet-filled world of death and destruction and put your combat skills to the test against thousands of highly trained special forces operatives, cultists, and otherworldly foes, who are out for your blood 

[*] [b]Explosive Campaign and Horde modes:[/b] Play through a thrilling campaign and unravel a deadly supernatural conspiracy, or take on waves of ruthless spec-ops forces and see how long you can survive 

[*] [b]Become enhanced:[/b] Master an arsenal of game-changing supernatural abilities including time distortion, invisibility, superhuman speed, and otherworldly strength to dominate your enemies 

[*] [b]Brutal melee combat:[/b] Pulverise foes in close quarters melee combat and eviscerate what’s left in rapid fire gunfights. Punch, kick, slide and string together combos to crush enemies to dust. 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/14Rd0M4.jpg[/img]
[i]The SPAS-12 will play a key part in our quest for demolition [/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZE2nF9C.jpg[/img]
[i]106's cloaking ability offers inconspicuous slaughter [/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fEV8shg.png[/img]
[i]You have two hands for a reason [/i]

[h3]What is Trepang2?
[/h3]
Trepang2 is our bloodstained love letter to first-person-shooters from the early 2000s. This journey features the carnage fuelled, bullet-ridden world of mayhem that you'd expect - but horrific realities also exist. The malevolent Silicon Valley HORIZON corp is experimenting with truly inconceivable abominations that you must uncover. It is your duty to contend with these other worldly, extraterrestrial-like foes and destroy them. 

HORIZON will be waiting. They know you're free. They know what to throw at you. They [i]think[/i] you can be beaten. Show them otherwise. 

This is Trepang2. We hope you have a blast. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bQbx2ho.png[/img]
[i]An abomination..[/i]

[h3]Stay up to date![/h3]

Follow Trepang Studios on [url=https://twitter.com/TrepangStudios]Twitter[/url] and join the community on [url=discord.gg/3KUwkEX]Discord[/url].

[h3]Player Support[/h3]

If you encounter any bugs or in-game issues, please contact our support team at: https://www.team17.com/support/ - they're more than happy to assist!

[h2]ENGAGE IN BLOODSHED. PLAY TREPANG 2 TODAY[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164940/Trepang2/

notes.title: The Patriarch - Wallpapers inside!
notes.content:
[h3]Trepang2 Community, [/h3]

We are less than a month out from release! Subject #106 will be tasked with breaking the cycle on June 21st. The malign Horizon institute is one of Silicon Valley’s revered pioneers in technology and manufacturing. But there’s a darkness to them; an unadulterated ambition to control and superseded their foes, predicated on horrific truths that you need to uncover. 

[h3]Adorn your desktop walls with some glorious new Trepang2 wallpapers! 
[/h3]

Far from civilization is an isolationist society of Cultists, a well armed fanatical group that's currently led by a man known only as The Patriarch. notes.title: Trepang 2 | Date Reveal Trailer & New Key Art!
notes.content:
[h3]Subject 106 breaks free from his chains to unleash mayhem — [b]June 21st[/b] on Steam! It's time to break the cycle.[/h3]

Trepang2 features high-octane, first-person gun-fu gunplay and puts players in the shoes of a newly enhanced super soldier on a mission of death, destruction, and revenge.

[i]Check your corners and blast into a brand-new story trailer below:[/i]
[previewyoutube=WLcy-agdpaM;full][/previewyoutube]

Broken out from a government black site by unknown allies and removed of their memories, they’ll be hunted by their captives and an even more otherworldly foe, and will have to arm themselves with an arsenal of devastating weapons and learn how to handle their newfound superhuman abilities to survive the onslaught, all the while unravelling a deadly conspiracy.  

[h3]Trepang2 key features[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Over-the-top Action:[/b] Dive into a bullet-filled world of death and destruction and put your combat skills to the test against thousands of highly trained special forces operatives who are out for your blood
[*] [b]Explosive Campaign and Horde modes:[/b] Play through a thrilling campaign and unravel a deadly supernatural conspiracy, or take on waves of ruthless spec-ops forces and see how long you can survive
[*] [b]Become Enhanced:[/b] Master an arsenal of game-changing supernatural abilities including time distortion, invisibility, superhuman speed and strength to dominate your enemies
[*] [b]Brutal Melee Combat: [/b]Square up to your foes in close quarters melee combat and go full throttle in rapid fire gunfights. Punch, kick, slide and string together combos to reduce your enemies to dust.
[/list]

[h3]New Key Art[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/moQ66cO.gif[/img]

Trepang2’s new key art is finalised! We wanted to illustrate Horizon frantically looking for an escape, aware of Subject 106’s intimidating presence in the shadows. The soldiers are on alert; they know the elite, genetically modified 106 is ready to pounce. Our protagonist disables his cloak, preparing to shift from covert surveillance to overt aggression.

The horror elements of Trepang2 play a significant part in our vision for the art. Yes, this game is about diabolic carnage and giblets hitting the walls — but terrifying, horrific realities also exist. We want to evoke fear in the aesthetic. 

Horizon know what they're up against, 106 is a by-product of their heinous endeavours. The formidable, unstoppable force takes on an immovable object. Chaos will ensue. Death, destruction and diabolic scenes await.

We’d love to address the imperious creature in the background and explain what on earth it is. But we think it’s best we leave that to you, Subject 106.

[h3]Screenshots to keep the violence at bay, for now.[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CP8XTn6.jpg[/img]
[i]Moments before an unfortunate solider evaporates[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k1gg0Mq.jpg[/img]
[i]The human anatomy poses potential for great horrors[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/96KCtlV.jpg[/img]
[i]Bang, bang, hang[/i]


Thank you for your continued support as ramp up to release! We can't wait to see you unleash havoc. 

[h3]Trepang2 releases on Steam, June 21st, 2023.[/h3]

To stay up to date, subscribe to the official [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TREPANG2]YouTube channel[/url], follow Trepang Studios on [url=https://twitter.com/TrepangStudios]Twitter[/url] and join the community on [url=discord.gg/3KUwkEX]Discord[/url]. 

[h3]Wishlist Trepang2, if you have a big gamer brain.[/h3]

notes.title: Complex Side Mission & Community Update
notes.content:
[h3]FPS fans, hello there![/h3]

A considerable amount of time has passed since we last reached out to give you folks an update on Trepang2! 

Following our delay last year, we’ve been knuckling down to ensure we meet our release window. We’re thrilled to confirm we will absolutely be releasing in 2023 – barring an unmitigated disaster (trepang3 anyone? lol) – and we have a date internally, which we’re working towards. 

Sorry for the massive disappointment if you were expecting something more specific. #Soon

The feedback from the demo has been incredibly valuable, and we love the madness the community brings to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/3KUwkEX]Discord[/url]. You’re all going to possess ample skill to inhabit Subject #106 – and wreak devastating havoc along the way. 

There’s lots of cool stuff in the pipeline. Spring is looking exciting for Trepang2 news! So keep an eye out. 

[h3]COMPLEX SIDE MISSION[/h3]

Following your feedback, we’ve made a litany of changes to improve the experience. You can even hack from anywhere, and don’t need to use the computer.

See our dev video showing this off, whilst we have a grand old time and continue to invoke Jesus throughout.

[previewyoutube=a-RtiY4xd6M;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ve pushed a montage live, showcasing some brutal clips from you all. You’re cracked, well done. Please continue to showcase the incredible scenes!

[previewyoutube=wBaI9Uy8STY;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re currently working on some new art and crazy trailers, we’ll keep you posted as soon as we’re ready to share.

Thanks for the support, as always.

March has been incredibly busy on our end. We've been pumping out side missions and getting Horde Mode Customization in. Not quite ready to show the newer stuff just yet, but we will definitely let everyone know the status on the 2022 Demo, and a more solid release date when we can.

notes.title: Progress Update - January 2022
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

We have been making a ton of progress for Trepang2 in January.

[h3]The Minigun[/h3]
[previewyoutube=_y8qhOnS_y4;full][/previewyoutube]What started as a kitbash ended up being a reality. We've had the minigun available in much older demos for Trepang2, but now, it's finally here and is even more devastating than before. We plan to make the wind-up/down sounds more prevalent and intense as the enemies who wield them are a true threat. 

[h3]Destructible Environments[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Q2jifoZiOCM;full][/previewyoutube]As you can probably tell, Trepang2 is a game about a Subject who has no regard for order. We still gotta balance the particle effects being a bit too much. This video pokes fun at it too.

[h3]Interactables[/h3]
[previewyoutube=XvNlCLbq7nI;full][/previewyoutube]To help the world not feel so static, we'll focus on a more interactable environment, such as computers, vending machines, and even this ridiculous Piano that could have a slew of easter eggs.

Behind the scenes however, we have been working really hard on the prologue map, the intro cutscene, a new side mission, and a bunch of tweaks to the main menu. We may show some of the progress in the coming weeks.

Thank you for being patient, the game releases this year, and when we have a more precise date, we will let everyone know as soon as we know.

notes.title: We're still alive!!! - Dev Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Surprise! Sorry for being radio silent, we’ve been incredibly busy working on Project Trepang2 in the shadows and realised we’d forgotten to let you know what we’ve been up to – our bad!

So first of all, why have we been quiet? Well, development is going well and we’ve been adding lots of the cool stuff the community has been asking us for! 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qLb5cc6EQBlupkMTlQ/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

We’re a super small team and we’ve been dedicating ourselves to making the game itself while hanging out with the community on our [url=http://trepang2.com/discord]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb3QQl9tReJ23RtwngqzTNA]YouTube [/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TrepangStudios/]Twitter[/url], rather than spreading ourselves too thin.

Because of the scope of the project we wanted to reassure you that despite launch not being in the near future, everything is going well and there will be lots of cool stuff to share with you when it's ready!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/s3Vl9hEgLejrRyZJ0c/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

Ultimately we’re not rushing Project Trepang2. Ever since we released our playable demo here on Steam back in 2019 (which we saw as an early proof of concept) we’ve been further fleshing out our vision for the game and with it, a hell of a lot more content.

That pretty much wraps things up for now! We’ll be in touch again when we have more to share, but if you want to come chat and hang out in the meantime, hit us up at the Twitter and Discord hyperlinks above.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wQitgtExZML6gJkqt5/giphy.gif[/img]

It’d be really awesome if you can drop us a Wishlist, not only does it support us while we work on the game, but it’ll keep you looped in on any information we share here such as content reveals, developer updates and other fun stuff.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164940/Trepang2/
Stay tuned for more Project Trepang2 goodness!
